'''Tev Matthews''' was a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. He was the father of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Ty Matthews]]. He was [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] to [[Death/Legends|death]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].
